snippet.title: Love Hues! Trailer
snippet.description:
Here's the trailer for Oneirocritica Games' first visual novel game, Love Hues! It's due to be released at the end of 2018.

About
Love Hues! follows your adventures as the player character (default name Skyler) as you navigate your first few months at Falls West University. This world renowned university isn't just popular for its state-of-the-art campus, faculty and programs, but also its rich history dating back to the little known "Great Curiosity." You'll soon meet other students who will shape your journey; as your relationships blossom, so will your knowledge of Falls' peculiar origins and everyone's individual secrets. Learn, remember and change the world's fate, but remember that the power to choose may have consequences...

Features
-Love Hues has over 100,000 words and counting!
-The game features over ~27 different endings and five full routes, including one secret route!
-Choose between 3 sets of pronouns; the five unique main characters are romanceable regardless of your choice! 
-Tired of seeing VN characters wearing the same outfits, day in and day out? Love Hues' characters each have 3 different outfits (and some have even more)!
-Created entirely by one developer with music by composer Moode Myoozik!
